item.title: Furiosos con Trump, demócratas de California planean estrategia electoral en San Francisco
item.description: En un año electoral crucial que servirá como referéndum sobre la segunda administración de Trump, los demócratas de California enfrentan presión de activistas de izquierda para que abandonen el “civismo radical” y en cambio respalden a candidatos que se opongan duramente al Partido Republicano.

item.title: Newsom appoints a new utilities regulator with a mandate to cut costs
item.description: The governor elevated a former self-driving car company lawyer to lead the California Public Utilities Commission, promising a renewed focus on cost cutting.

item.title: Silicon Valley flexes financial muscle in governor’s race and wealth tax battle
item.description: Compared to other sectors of California's economy, Silicon Valley hasn't doled out as much campaign money or hired as many lobbyists — until now.

item.title: Modern parenting means apps for sports, school and more. Where is the data going?
item.description: California is a national leader in data privacy. Yet state law has gaps that allow companies to collect and sell students’ data.

item.title: The problem is clear: Medi-Cal is failing to protect children’s eyesight
item.description: Poor children are struggling at school because of undetected and uncorrected vision problems. Medi-Cal has been neglecting vision care.

item.title: Sanders rallies for CA’s proposed billionaire tax
item.description: At a rally in Los Angeles to drum up support for a proposed “billionaire tax” in California, U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders gave a warning to his audience: Beware of deceptive messaging. item.title: California expanding services for immigrants amid Trump’s deportation push
item.description: California continues to support legal defense for immigrants facing deportation despite a tight state budget and projections calling for deficits.

item.title: U.S. Supreme Court strikes down Trump’s tariffs. Here’s how they’ve affected California
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled that President Trump does not have the authority to impose broad tariffs under the emergency act he has cited. Tariffs have affected California ports, farms, businesses, workers and consumers.

item.title: Where death chamber once stood, Newsom shows off prison remodel emphasizing rehabilitation
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom suspended the death penalty and ordered the dismantling of death row. He unveiled changes at San Quentin that include a new education center.

item.title: California lawmakers blocked from entering Otay Mesa Detention Center despite prior clearance
item.description: Sen. Alex Padilla and two San Diego County supervisors were blocked from inspecting the Otay Mesa Detention Center on Friday despite having received clearance from ICE days prior.
